title: Rental demand is up 20% as high lending costs stifle the for-sale market

# Press releases


# Rental demand is up 20% as high lending costs stifle the for-sale market


Oct 15, 2026


*With the typical monthly payment for a new homeowner climbing nearly twice as fast as rent, more shoppers are turning to rentals*


- Rental demand is up 19.2% year over year nationwide, as measured by the Zillow Observed Renter Demand Index (ZORDI).1
- The typical U.S. rent was $1,932 a month in September, up 2.7% from a year ago.
- The financial advantage of renting is growing, as the typical new home buyer's monthly payment2 is climbing nearly twice as fast as rent, up 5% from a year ago to $3,037.


SEATTLE


, Oct. 15, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Housing demand doesn't disappear when buying becomes harder financially. Instead, it finds a new home in the rental market. The Zillow Observed Renter Demand Index (ZORDI), an indicator of rental demand, rose 19.2% year over year as elevated borrowing costs push would-be buyers to rent instead, according to the latest[Zillow® Rental Market Report](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4798668-1&h=2394692557&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.zillow.com%2Fresearch%2Fseptember-2026-rent-report%2F&a=Zillow%C2%AE+Rental+Market+Report) .


Rents are climbing, but buying costs are climbing faster. Typical rent is $1,932 a month, up 2.7% from a year ago. By comparison, the typical new home buyer's monthly payment has risen 5%, to $3,037, nearly double the pace.


"Elevated mortgage rates have pushed home shoppers straight into the arms of rentals," said Kara Ng, senior economist at Zillow. "Homeownership has long been a way for families to build wealth, but with the rise in borrowing costs, we're seeing the rise of the deliberate renter, someone who chooses to bank the difference between a buyer's monthly payment and rent, and build wealth without owning a home."


And for many home shoppers, what they still want is a house. ZORDI shows demand for single-family rentals up 21.6% from a year ago, more than double the 10.1% rise for multifamily rentals. At a typical rent of $2,266, renting a house offers the space and lifestyle shoppers want without a down payment or the hidden costs of owning, and it costs $771 less each month than a buyer's monthly payment.


For shoppers weighing renting against buying, Zillow's[rent vs. buy research](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4798668-1&h=571845413&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.zillow.com%2Fresearch%2Fbuy-vs-rent-breakeven%2F&a=%C2%A0rent+vs.+buy+research) breaks down the break-even timeline by metro, that timeline being the number of years a household would need to own before buying comes out ahead.


**Rental demand surges in the Bay Area and the Sun Belt** Rental demand rose the most in San Jose, where ZORDI is up 82.5% from a year ago, followed by San Francisco (66.9%), Austin (49.3%), Miami (48.9%) and Phoenix (43%).


Rent growth over the past year was also fastest in California's Bay Area, where typical rent is up 11.8% in San Francisco and 8.3% in San Jose. In the other markets where demand has jumped the most, rent growth was more moderate, at 0.7% in Austin, 1.8% in Miami and 1% in Phoenix, as new construction has kept supply in step with demand.


Not every market is following the national trend. ZORDI is down year over year in markets that include Louisville (down 6.2%), Baltimore (-6.1%), Washington, D.C. (-5.6%) and Cleveland (-5.5%).


**Affordability holds steady for renters** The median household spends 26.3% of its income on a new rental, essentially unchanged from a year ago, compared with 41.3% spent by a new homeowner. A household needs an income of $77,278 to afford a typical rental versus $121,496 to afford a typical home, a gap of more than $44,000.


For renters who are ready to make a move, Zillow brings together apartments, single-family homes and rooms for rent in one place, and[Zillow's portable rental application](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4798668-1&h=3254249237&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.zillow.com%2Frent%2Fapply-for-rentals%2F&a=%C2%A0Zillow%27s+portable+rental+application) makes applying simpler: one form, one flat fee and 30 days to apply to as many participating properties as needed.
